{{Top|leg}}
'''Acquisition cell one''', used to hold captured [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]], was one of three holding cells found aboard the [[Mist Hunter/Legends|''Mist Hunter'']], a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was owned by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]].

[[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]], Zuckuss's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] partner, once used the cell to practice [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]]. After his own meditation, Zuckuss searched the ship and found 4-LOM in this cell, sitting on a bunk, with his legs crossed. When asked what he was doing, 4-LOM replied that he was "attempting meditation." The two eventually entered into a brief argument, with Zuckuss accusing 4-LOM of trying to steal his [[The Force/Legends|intuition]].
